_comment: How tools/list describes a tool that declares the events it subscribes to (TypeScript attached.registerTool(name, { subscribes }, handler) or wrap, Go wakeshift.AddTool with Subscribes, Python @attached.tool(subscribes=...)): the tool's description exactly as written (whitespace inside it kept; trailing whitespace dropped), then a space (a blank line if the description has more than one line), then EVENT_TOOL_TEXT.notifies with " of this event: <description>" (or " of these events: <d1>; <d2>") in place of {when}. app is the app's name as GET /app gives it, used exactly as written ("": this app, capitalized where it starts a sentence); events are the declared events' descriptions. Shared by the three SDKs.

_compact_comment: Next release (design §2.4, §2.12): the subscribes sentence, from subscribes, always, in today's wording (event-tools.json notifies, notifies_event, notifies_events, notifies_events_separator), which the compact tools/list bench kept. notifies() is gone, so a description is never checked for an existing sentence. Same inputs and normalization as cases: the description's whitespace collapsed and trimmed; each event description's whitespace collapsed, trailing periods and spaces trimmed, duplicates named once; the app's name ("": "this app") as given after "how", capitalized where it starts a sentence; an empty description gives the sentence alone; no events leaves the description unchanged. FINAL (compact tools/list bench, 2026-11-05: compact matched or beat the baseline in every cell). compact_strings in subscribing-tools-list.json is the one place these strings live; every literal that uses them (wake-args.json compact, subscribes.json compact_cases, event-tools.json, events-list.json tools, subscribing-tools-list.json scenarios, tool-output-schemas.json) is generated from it. A one-line description that doesn't end its last sentence (its last character, after any closing quotes, parentheses or brackets, isn't . ! ? or …) gets a period before the space; a multi-line one is left as written.
